text: That said, this isn't the nature of things. This is in the nature of humanity and in the nature of economy that changes cannot be stopped. The world is always changing, and this is attested to by the objective facts over the last five years. And I think these statistics have already been cited by our colleague from Indonesia. Over the last five years, more than 40% of the world GDP have been produced by the BRICS countries, whereas the contribution of the so-called G7, the Great Seven, well, I don't know why they call that that the group of seven, it stands at only 29%.
